series.name: Splits & cabinets — e/eSMART/eGrande/eTitan/Luxury (shared platform)
series.notes: Kenwood Pakistan wall splits and assembled cabinets (e, eSMART, eGrande, eTitan, eComfort, eIcon, Glory/Luxury Pro/Ultra, Superia floor-standing) share one E/F/P + numeric display platform across InverterOn-style T3 lines. No public Kenwood AC service manual PDF found. Core table (E0–E5, EC, EE · F0–F6 · P0/P1/P3/P4/P6/P7) is identical across Electra Fix, Japan Electronics, and AYS Online — confidence high. Numeric 6/19/36 = Electra Fix deep sections only (medium). Error 20 = video title only (low). Reset: remote OFF → breaker OFF 5–10 min → breaker ON → remote ON. Official site: kenwoodpakistan.pk.

meaning.en: The indoor unit's memory chip (EEPROM) cannot be read — stored settings are corrupt or the chip failed.

causes.ur: Indoor PCB par EEPROM chip kharab

solutions.en: Power cycle first: remote off → breaker off 5–10 min → breaker on → remote on

solutions.en: If it returns: technician EEPROM reflash or indoor PCB replacement
solutions.ur: Wapas aaye to technician EEPROM reflash ya indoor PCB badle
